text:
jen-support: @chris-oncall customer NeptuneApps reporting repeated 429s this morning on their Dedicated pool after plan migration. Customer says traffic steady, latency normal, but sudden throttles for several minutes. sample client header: `x-rw-rl-reason: tenant_quota_exceeded`, `x-rw-remaining: 0`
chris-oncall: can you paste the tenant id and pool id? any correlating alerts?
jen-support: tenant_id=tn-8923, pool=dedicated-us-east-2-42. No high CPU/gpu alerts on console for that pool. Alert: `quota-consumption-spike` at 09:12 UTC matching customer 429 window.
alex-infra: digging into quota table now. quick query I ran:```sql
-- db: config
SELECT id, tenant_id, scope, denom, units, created_at FROM tenant_quotas WHERE tenant_id='tn-8923' ORDER BY created_at;
```
alex-infra: result snippet:```csv
id,tenant_id,scope,denom,units,created_at
q_101,tn-8923,reserved_pool,hour,3600,2025-02-18T08:00:12Z
q_202,tn-8923,reserved_pool,minute,60,2025-02-18T08:00:13Z
q_303,tn-8923,reserved_pool,hour,3600,2025-02-18T08:00:13Z  -- DUPLICATE
```
maya-sre: interesting — looks like two identical hourly quotas applied. our rate calc aggregates all active quota rows for tenant+scope, so duplicates would double-count the limit but the enforcement layer mistakenly dedupes on `quota_key` during evaluation leading to an off-by-one where the remaining counter hits 0 faster. this can manifest as bursty 429s while autoscaler stays idle.
jen-support: how would a duplicate row get created? they did a plan-migrate via support UI earlier today.
alex-infra: likely race in plan-migration job: job creates new quota, then a background import replay re-applied legacy quotas without checking for existing rows. I see a migration job id mug-973 in job_runs table for 2025-02-18 08:00:13Z.
chris-oncall: repro steps to validate? can we recreate locally / replay safe query?
alex-infra: steps I used to reproduce in staging: 1) create tenant with baseline hourly quota 3600 2) run plan-migrate job (v2) which writes a new hourly quota 3) run legacy-import with same tenant -> inserts duplicate row. Then hit quota viewer API: `GET /admin/quotas?tenant=tn-8923` shows both entries. Enforcement pipeline: throttle eval sums by active rows -> enforcement dedupe by fingerprint -> remaining tokens off.
maya-sre: quick mitigation: stop legacy-import replay for that day (paused job id: import-replay-20250218), run cleanup to merge duplicate quotas for impacted tenants, and patch plan-migrate to `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` on (tenant_id,scope,denom,units).
alex-infra: commands I ran:```bash
# mark job paused
curl -X POST https://ops-api/jobs/import-replay-20250218/pause -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
# cleanup duplicate quotas (dry-run first)
psql -c "WITH dups AS (SELECT tenant_id, scope, denom, units, array_agg(id) ids FROM tenant_quotas GROUP BY tenant_id,scope,denom,units HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT tenant_id,scope,denom,units,ids FROM dups WHERE tenant_id='tn-8923';"
# then keep first id and delete rest (production only after review)
"DELETE FROM tenant_quotas WHERE id IN (SELECT unnest(ids[2:]) FROM dups WHERE tenant_id='tn-8923');"
```
jen-support: customer is on a support call now asking for ETA. can we give a quick patch ETA?
chris-oncall: mitigation first: pause the import job (done?), then run targeted cleanup for tn-8923. Alex, can you run cleanup with me watching?
alex-infra: pausing import-replay now -> deploy-bot: job import-replay-20250218 paused by alex-infra at 2025-02-18T09:05:22Z
alex-infra: I'll run the cleanup dry-run and then delete the duplicate. will push a small migration to add unique constraint on (tenant_id,scope,denom,created_by) as longer-term guard.
maya-sre: after cleanup, we should also trigger `quota-sync` across the dedicated pool to recompute token buckets so autoscaler sees correct usage. command: `servicectl quota-sync --pool dedicated-us-east-2-42 --tenant tn-8923`
chris-oncall: plan: 1) pause import job (done) 2) cleanup duplicates for tn-8923 (alex+chris) 3) trigger quota-sync (maya) 4) confirm with customer & monitor for 20m 5) ship quick DB constraint in next deploy and add safe-guard to plan-migrate job. owner: alex-infra for cleanup + PR.
jen-support: customer updated: they see fewer 429s but still some; will stay on call for 15m. thanks. :pray:
maya-sre: followups: add regression test for plan-migrate + legacy-import in staging, and add alert when a tenant's quota rows increase >1 in <5s window.
chris-oncall: assigning incident ticket INC-20250218-tn8923 to alex-infra + maya-sre + jen-support.
alex-infra: cleanup complete: duplicate q_303 removed, quota-sync ran, customer flows are green per our internal sampling. deploying DB constraint PR #8421 to staging for verification.
jen-support: customer confirmed they're back to normal and will close ticket after 30m. I'll update the tenant's case notes. :white_check_mark:
maya-sre: thanks team — please add postmortem with timeline + contributing factors after incident is fully closed.
